messages:
deploy-bot: staged rollout initiating: service=embed-indexer, from=redwood/embed-v4.2.0 to=redwood/embed-v4.3.0, target=3% (us-west-2), rollout_id=rl-4788, change_window=2026-04-01T18:00Z..19:00Z
release-manager: release notes: https://go/redwood/releases/4.3.0 — main change is tokenization normalization + small float->int packing optimization. QA smoke green.
kai: is this the packed-int variant we discussed? Any compatibility caveats?
leah: yes packed-int, runtime flag pack.int_mode=packed_small. Compatible with current decoder; perf notes in doc.
qa-lead: quick FYI — preflight eval auto-run showed a minor cosine-sim drop on long-tail queries (~0.9%). Not huge but noticed.
sre-oncall: SRE watches: p99 latency, 5xx rate, kvcache.evictions. Auto-rollback rule currently 5xx > 0.4% sustained 8m.
tom: infra: pin canary to us-west-2a to avoid cross-az noise.
deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 3% us-west-2a. phase=running.
leah: I'm going to enable the permissive tokenizer flag on canary only so we can isolate normalization impact. deploy-bot?
deploy-bot: runtime flag applied: rl-4788.tokenizer.mode=permissive for rollout_id=rl-4788.
qa-lead: running real-time eval on user-sim samples. posting snapshots in the doc.
qa-lead: observed: embedding-sim drop unexpectedly spikes to ~3.5% on a subset of long conversation histories at 18:03Z.
kai: that's higher than preflight. Can you paste a sample?
qa-lead: sample diff in docs — gist attached. Short note: drift appears only when history_len > 1024 and when punctuation-normalization hits.
sre-oncall: infra metrics show no 5xx spike yet, but p99 is +22% vs baseline for the canary hosts. Not at alert threshold.
leah: maybe permissive tokenizer mode is exposing normalized token ordering edge-case. I can flip the tokenizer flag back to strict for canary temporarily.
release-manager: decision? Stop / throttle / rollback? We should be conservative since embeddings used by search.
tom: I recommend we PAUSE ramp and throttle concurrency to 6 for canary while QA digs in. No full rollback yet.
kai: agree with pause. Also add an automatic rollback trigger: if embedding-sim drop > 2.5% for 10m -> rollback to v4.2.0.
sre-oncall: implementable. I'll add synthetic metric watch: embed.sim_drop > 2.5% for 10m -> auto-rollback, and keep 5xx rule as is. Adding playbook link to alert.
deploy-bot: applying concurrency override: concurrency=6 for rl-4788; adding auto-rollback rule for embed.sim_drop > 2.5% over 10m.
qa-lead: after throttling, sim_drop reduced to 1.4% at 18:08Z on sampled set. p99 trending down.
leah: rolling tokenizer.flag back to strict on canary now.
deploy-bot: updated runtime flag: rl-4788.tokenizer.mode=strict (canary override).
release-manager: marking thread HOLD at 3% until 18:20Z. If embed.sim_drop spikes again above 2.5% or 5xx crosses the SRE threshold -> auto-rollback. Otherwise we'll consider ramp to 15%.
kai: fine. If anyone wants an immediate rollback, type exactly "rollback" in thread.
qa-lead: I'll continue sampling and post any failing examples.
sre-oncall: monitoring dashboards and traces. Will escalate to infra if we start seeing allocator failures or OOM restarts.
tom: infra patches applied for pinned nodepool. Observability should reflect new concurrency in ~90s.
leah: thanks all. pushing a ticket GH-4398 to investigate normalization order with long histories.
release-manager: thanks team 44b next sync 18:20Z or earlier on signal.
